en.shortDescription: Self-hosted file sync and sharing platform
en.longDescription:
Seafile is an open-source file sync and share platform for teams and organizations.

Includes MariaDB and Redis. Admin login uses SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL and SERVICE_PASSWORD_SEAFILE_ADMIN on first launch.

de.longDescription:

Enthält MariaDB und Redis. Der Admin-Login verwendet beim ersten Start SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL und SERVICE_PASSWORD_SEAFILE_ADMIN.

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme auto-hébergée de synchronisation et de partage de fichiers

Inclut MariaDB et Redis. La connexion admin utilise SEAFILE_ADMIN_EMAIL et SERVICE_PASSWORD_SEAFILE_ADMIN au premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: Plataforma auto-hospedada de sincronização e compartilhamento de arquivos
